description:
**Severity: high · Dimension: doc-drift** (report finding #7)

Four F_3 FFI doc sites in `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/permanent/mod.rs` (lines 33, 57, 269, 324) claim `permanent_bipedal3_singleword` supports n=64 via a u128 counter. The function asserts `n <= 63` and panics for n=64 (a `#[should_panic]` test confirms this). The parallel F_5 docs (lines 85-86) were correctly updated; the F_3 docs were not synchronized.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All four F_3 doc sites state the correct bound (`n <= 63`) using the same language as the corrected F_5 docs.
- [hard] REQ-02: The false "u128 counter enables n=64" claim is removed from all four sites.
- [hard] REQ-03: Bound matches the actual `assert!`/`#[should_panic]` behaviour in code (verified).
title: Correct F_3 permanent n<=63 bound in gf2-kernels-hip FFI docs
